scoreBasis.cohesion: Rules and state contracts only: clear completion/rhythm/Maestro thresholds, honest percentage flooring, conserved legacy access, read-only future formats, and commit-before-celebration rewards. Favorite pending work deliberately follows a different, clearly stated retention contract. Escape dismissal breaks the otherwise shared round-exit lifecycle.

A verified Escape lifecycle omission remains. No claim about browser execution or rendered finish.

strengths.detail: Garden add, remove, set save and set load share a failed-write rollback, while discovered cards remain owned. This respects the value of a collection and avoids charging a player for a failed persistence operation. The fixture specifies nonconsumption, retry and future-format preservation; it was not run here.

A failed favorite addition intentionally retains unsaved work, labels it pending, exposes repair, and withholds the saved-place lesson/reward. Destructive edits instead restore prior values. These different contracts suit the cost of each action and are explicit in code.

Rewards, personal notes and chapter restoration form one save operation before celebration. Rollback preserves relevant object identities, prevents duplicate payment on retry, and future saves receive a locked view. Displayed rhythm percentages floor rather than implying an unmet threshold has been earned.

findings.detail: Escape dismisses mPlace by setting hidden directly and saving. The visible Salir control additionally returns the player to the entry portal and calls songFinaleCheck. Therefore keyboard dismissal after completing the eleventh place or the 33rd star skips the automatic finale/master check, and ordinary round dismissal skips the portal return.
findings.consequence: The same close action has different game outcomes by input method. A keyboard player can finish the game and see no automatic finale until another qualifying result card is closed through its button.
findings.remedy: Route Escape for mapped dialogs through their existing close control, including placeClose, keeping bespoke stage dismissal where needed. Verify final-place and master-result Escape dismissal invokes the same return/finale lifecycle as Salir. This is verified from control flow, not reproduced in a browser.
